svg.title: capcom loading screen
svg.desc: The pull requests and runs panels while their first data loads: a 1960s Mission Control go/no-go poll, and a launch-pad countdown and checklist, each above a moving signal strip.

g.font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
